newsitem.title: USA: Ortel sees Q2 earnings of $0.16 per share.
newsitem.headline: Ortel sees Q2 earnings of $0.16 per share.

text.p: Ortel Corp said it expects earnings per share for its second fiscal quarter to be about $0.16, versus $0.14 for the first quarter and $0.13 for the year-ago second quarter.

Ortel said it expects to report sales of about $20.5 million for its second fiscal quarter ended October 31, versus $17.3 million for the immediately preceding first fiscal quarter and $14.4 million for the second quarter a year ago.
The company will report complete results for its second quarter and six-month periods ended October 31, 1996 on Tuesday, November 26, 1996, at the close of market.
